The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the fifth season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, ''[[S05|Master Quest]]'', in {{pmin|the United States}} and {{pmin|Canada}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 1}}). In Region 1 releases, the episodes are ordered and separated according to [[VIZ Media]] season (which correspond to [[List of English opening themes|opening themes]]), rather than by standard [[season]]s (in the same way as on [[Pokémon.com]]). ==Box sets== Two Master Quest DVD box sets were released by [[VIZ Media|Viz Video]] and Ventura Distribution between 2004-2005, containing the whole season between them. There are two boxed sets each containing three DVD cases with one disc each. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs. ===Quest 1: Episodes 1-32=== [[File:Master Quest Box 1 Cover.png|thumb|200px|Pokémon: Master Quest - Quest 1]] Pokémon: Master Quest - Quest 1 was released by [[VIZ Media]] on October 26, 2004. It contains three discs with 32 episodes across them combined. ''[[EP274|Hoenn Alone!]]'' |} ==The Complete Collection== [[File:Master Quest Region 1 The Complete Collection.png|thumb|200px|right|Pokémon - Master Quest: The Complete Collection]] Pokémon - Master Quest: The Complete Collection was released on October 11, 2016 by [[VIZ Media]] and distributed through {{wp|Warner Home Video}}. This [[Complete Collection]] contains seven discs with 64 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is 3000068037. This release consists of a single DVD case in a slip cover. Optional English closed captioning is included. This release features the versions of episodes without the broadcast edits, in contrast to the first US home video release which does feature the censorship such as the edits in [[EP245]] and [[EP247]]. {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Johto}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Johto}}; {{roundy|10px}}" !
